Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner shifted from the correct plan of comparing directors’ birth years to an incorrect approach of comparing their ages at each film’s release. This misinterprets the question (“whose director is younger”) and would lead to the wrong conclusion (favoring Joe Palooka instead of the correct Figaro-ci, Figaro-là). Subsequent steps even inverted the logic (“larger age value has the younger director”), compounding the error, but the first mistake occurred at Step 9.
